title: ECE4450 L26: Sallen-Key Filters & the Korg MS-20 VCF
summary: In-depth analysis of the early (KORG35) and late (LM13600 OTA) MS-20 filters: the Sallen-Key topology, transistors in reverse saturation used as current-controlled resistors, the exponential cutoff control and the diode-limited resonance loop that gives the filter its aggressive character.
